units.name: Battering Ram
units.description:
Durable infantry transport effective against buildings and walls.
+ High ranged armor
+ High health
- Takes bonus damage from melee attacks
- Can only attack buildings
- Slow movement speed

units.name: Bombard
units.description:
Intimidating siege gun excellent against buildings or any stubborn targets.
+ High damage
- Must be set up to fire

units.name: Carrack
units.description:
Large sailed war vessel armed with broadside cannons.
+ Anti-structure specialist
- Low movement speed

units.name: Counterweight Trebuchet
units.description:
Powerful siege engine effective at destroying buildings and walls over a great distance.
+ Bonus damage vs buildings
- Must be set up to fire
- Inaccurate against units

units.name: Crossbowman
units.description:
High damage ranged unit best against heavy targets.
+ Anti-heavy specialist
- Low health
- Countered by Horsemen

units.name: Elite Crossbowman
units.description:
High damage ranged unit best against heavy targets.
+ Anti-heavy specialist
- Low health
- Countered by Horsemen

units.name: Demolition Ship
units.description:
Small ship packed with explosives. Detonates when killed, damaging any units in the area.
- Damage is reduced further from the explosion center
- No weapons other than self-destruction

units.name: Fishing Boat
units.description:
Small boat that gathers Food from either Deep Water Fish or Shoreline Fish. Drops off gathered resources at the Dock.
+ Can repair
- No combat

units.name: Galley
units.description:
Oared war vessel armed with a crew of archers.
+ Increased maneuverability
+ Benefits from ranged damage Blacksmith technology

units.name: Handcannoneer
units.description:
Powerful all-purpose ranged infantry.
+ High damage
- High cost
- Slow movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

units.name: Horseman
units.description:
Fast cavalry effective at raiding, flanking, and countering ranged units.
+ High movement speed
- Weak against melee units
- Countered by Spearmen

units.name: Veteran Horseman
units.description:
Fast cavalry effective at raiding, flanking, and countering ranged units.
+ High movement speed
- Weak against melee units
- Countered by Spearmen

units.name: Elite Horseman
units.description:
Fast cavalry effective at raiding, flanking, and countering ranged units.
+ High movement speed
- Weak against melee units
- Countered by Spearmen

units.name: Hulk
units.description:
Ship equipped with broadside ballistae.
+ Strong against Arrow Ships
- Lower maneuverability

units.name: King
units.description:
A mighty King, a powerful heavy cavalry unit. Heals nearby out of combat units by 2 health every 1 seconds.
+ Heavy armor
+ Strong in melee combat
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

units.name: Knight
units.description:
Expensive cavalry with high damage and melee armor. Effective against melee units.
+ Heavy armor
+ Strong in melee combat
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

units.name: Elite Knight
units.description:
Expensive cavalry with high damage and melee armor. Effective against melee units.
+ Heavy armor
+ Strong in melee combat
- Countered by Spearmen and Crossbowmen

units.name: Longbowman
units.description:
Cheap long-ranged infantry with good damage vs. unarmored targets.
+ Long range
+ Can construct Palings to fend off cavalry charges
- Slow movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

units.name: Veteran Longbowman
units.description:
Cheap long-ranged infantry with good damage vs. unarmored targets.
+ Long range
+ Can construct Palings to fend off cavalry charges
- Slow movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

units.name: Elite Longbowman
units.description:
Cheap long-ranged infantry with good damage vs. unarmored targets.
+ Long range
+ Can construct Palings to fend off cavalry charges
- Slow movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

units.name: Vanguard Man-at-Arms
units.description:
Tough infantry with good damage.
+ High armor
- Slow movement
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

units.name: Early Man-at-Arms
units.description:
Tough infantry with good damage.
+ High armor
- Slow movement
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

units.name: Man-at-Arms
units.description:
Tough infantry with good damage.
+ High armor
- Slow movement
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

units.name: Elite Man-at-Arms
units.description:
Tough infantry with good damage.
+ High armor
- Slow movement
- Countered by Knights, Lancers, and Crossbowmen

units.name: Mangonel
units.description:
Fires multiple projectiles dealing damage in an area.
+ Effective against massed units
- Must be set up to fire

units.name: Monk
units.description:
Support unit with no combat capability. Can pick up Relics, convert enemy units, and capture Sacred Sites.
+ Heals friendly units
- Slow movement speed

units.name: Ribauldequin
units.description:
Five-barreled gunpowder weapon effective against massed units. Deals little damage to buildings.
+ Can hit multiple targets in a single volley
- Short range
- Low ranged armor

units.name: Scout
units.description:
Lightly armed cavalry effective at exploring the world, hunting wildlife, and herding Sheep.
+ Able to see into Stealth Forests
+ Health regeneration
+ High movement speed
- Very weak in combat

units.name: Siege Tower
units.description:
Tall infantry transport with no combat capability. Allows garrisoned infantry to be unloaded directly onto Stone Walls.
+ High ranged armor
- Cannot attack
- Slow movement speed

units.name: Hardened Spearman
units.description:
Infantry best used against mounted units.
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants
- Weak against heavy infantry
- Countered by Archers

units.name: Veteran Spearman
units.description:
Infantry best used against mounted units.
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants
- Weak against heavy infantry
- Countered by Archers

units.name: Elite Spearman
units.description:
Infantry best used against mounted units.
+ Anti-cavalry specialist
+ Additional damage against Elephants
- Weak against heavy infantry
- Countered by Archers

units.name: Springald
units.description:
Anti-unit siege weapon. Fires bolts that pierce multiple units.
+ Does not require setup to fire
+ Bonus damage vs. melee infantry
- Trivial damage vs. buildings

units.name: Trade Ship
units.description:
Trade Ships generate Gold and Wood when assigned to a trade route with a Coastal Trade Post or another player's Dock.
- No combat

units.name: Trader
units.description:
Traders generate Gold by travelling between their Home Market and a Trade Post or another player's Market. Greater distances between the Home Market and trade destination will generate higher amounts of Gold.
The Home Market or Trade destination may be changed at any time.

units.name: Transport Ship
units.description:
Large oared vessel able to transport land units across water.
+ Can be garrisoned by any unit
+ Uses sight range of units in garrison
- No combat

units.name: Villager
units.description:
Gathers Wood, Food, Stone, and Gold. Builds and repairs buildings and can repair siege engines and naval units.
+ Uses a bow to attack
- Weak in combat

units.name: Wynguard Army
units.description: Produces an army of 2 Spearmen, 2 Crossbowmen, and a Trebuchet.

units.name: Wynguard Footman
units.description:
Specialized man at arms with high health and pierce armor.
- Slow movement
- Countered by Crossbowmen

units.name: Wynguard Footmen
units.description: Produces an army of 6 Wynguard Footmen.

units.name: Wynguard Raiders
units.description: Produces an army of 3 Horsemen and 3 Knights.

units.name: Wynguard Ranger
units.description:
Master longbowmen with increased range and damage, good vs. unarmored targets.
+ Long range
+ Can construct Palings to fend off cavalry charges
- Slow movement speed
- Countered by Horsemen

units.name: Wynguard Rangers
units.description: Produces an army of 6 Wynguard Rangers.

buildings.name: Abbey of Kings
buildings.description: Heals all nearby friendly units that are out of combat by +6 every 1 seconds. May also Crown a King, a powerful cavalry leader with a healing aura. Queues production of a free King upon completion.

buildings.name: Archery Range
buildings.description: Produces ranged infantry units.

buildings.name: Barracks
buildings.description: Produces melee infantry units.

buildings.name: Berkshire Palace
buildings.description: Acts as a Keep with increased health and powerful incendiary arrows. All weapons have 14.5 tiles of range.

buildings.name: Blacksmith
buildings.description: Houses technology to improve infantry and cavalry.

buildings.name: Capital Town Center
buildings.description:
All Resources can be dropped off here. Produces Villagers, Scouts, and increases your maximum Population. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.
Network of Castles: Nearby enemies trigger an alarm that increases defenders' attack speed.
Capital Town Centers can detect units stealth or disguises.

buildings.name: Cathedral of St. Thomas
buildings.description: Build and defend a Wonder to secure victory. Rival civilizations will be aware of its construction and seek to destroy it.

buildings.name: Council Hall
buildings.description:
Acts as an Archery Range with all units and technologies. Works +100% faster.
Longbowmen produced from this landmark are -5% cheaper.

buildings.name: Dock
buildings.description:
Produces naval units.
Automatically repairs nearby damaged naval units.
Capable of holding up to three Fishing Ships.

buildings.name: Farm
buildings.description:
Harvestable Food source. Use a Villager to gather Food from the Farm.
Only one Villager can work each Farm.
influences: Farm harvest rate increased +20%/+25%/+30%/+30% by Age while within the influence of a Mill.

buildings.name: House
buildings.description: Increases your maximum Population.

buildings.name: Keep
buildings.description:
Heavy garrison and defensible position. Can be upgraded with weaponry. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.
Network of Castles Bonus: Triggers an alarm when an enemy approaches, causing nearby units to fire faster while the alarm is active.

buildings.name: King's Palace
buildings.description: Acts as a Town Center. Produces Villagers +10% faster.

buildings.name: Lumber Camp
buildings.description: Villagers can drop off Wood at this building. Houses technologies to improve Wood gathering.

buildings.name: Market
buildings.description: Allows the buying and selling of resources and produces the Trader.

buildings.name: Mill
buildings.description: Villagers can drop off Food at this building. Houses technologies to improve Food gathering.
influences: Farm harvest rate increased +20%/+25%/+30%/+30% by Age while within the influence of a Mill.

buildings.name: Mining Camp
buildings.description: Villagers can drop off Stone and Gold at this building. Houses technologies to improve mining.

buildings.name: Monastery
buildings.description: Produces religious units and houses religious technologies. Starting in the Castle Age (III), religious units can pick up Relics and place them in this building to generate Gold.

buildings.name: Outpost
buildings.description:
Offers extensive line of sight and detects units stealth or disguises. Can be upgraded with weaponry and fortifications. Attacks while garrisoned.
Network of Castles Bonus: Triggers an alarm when an enemy approaches, causing nearby units and defensive buildings to fire faster while the alarm is active.

buildings.name: Palisade
buildings.description: Light defensive wall for quickly fortifying an area.

buildings.name: Palisade Gate
buildings.description: Light defensive gate. Must be built on a Palisade Wall segment.

buildings.name: Siege Workshop
buildings.description: Produces siege engines and powerful gunpowder units.

buildings.name: Stable
buildings.description: Produces cavalry military units.

buildings.name: Stone Wall
buildings.description:
Sturdy wall that cannot be attacked by torches. 
Units on walls take 25% less damage from ranged attacks, 50% less damage from siege attacks, and their range is increased by +1.

buildings.name: Stone Wall Gate
buildings.description:
Heavy defensive gate. Must be built on a Stone Wall segment.
Infantry can use the gate to access the top of the walls.

buildings.name: Stone Wall Tower
buildings.description:
Heavy defensive tower that fires a springald. Must be built on a Stone Wall segment.
Infantry can use the tower to access the top of the walls.
Network of Castles: Nearby enemies trigger an alarm that increases defenders' fire rate.

buildings.name: The White Tower
buildings.description: Acts as a Keep with all the behaviors, technologies, and bonuses. Works 75% faster.

buildings.name: Town Center
buildings.description:
All Resources can be dropped off here. Produces Villagers, Scouts, and increases your Population. Adds additional attacks while garrisoned.
Network of Castles: Nearby enemies trigger an alarm that increases defenders' attack speed.
Non-Capital Town Centers can't detect stealth or disguises.

buildings.name: University
buildings.description: Houses advanced technology that benefit the civilization.

buildings.name: Wynguard Palace
buildings.description: Allows production of 4 battalions: Wynguard Army, Wynguard Rangers, Wynguard Raiders, and Wynguard Footmen.

technologies.name: Balanced Projectiles

technologies.name: Enclosures

technologies.name: Explosives

Increase the production speed of infantry, cavalry, siege, and transport units at buildings by 33%.

technologies.name: Professional Scouts

Scouts gain the ability to carry animal carcasses and +100% damage against wild animals.
Scouts move -55% slower while carrying and cannot pick up Boar. Deer slowly decay while being carried.

technologies.name: Roller Shutter Triggers
technologies.description: Increases Springald attack speed by +30% and grants +10% Ranged Resistance.

technologies.name: Serpentine Powder

technologies.name: Shaft Mining

technologies.name: Siege Engineering
technologies.description: Melee and ranged infantry can construct Siege Towers and Battering Rams in the field.

technologies.name: Siege Works
technologies.description: New carpentry techniques increase the health of siege units by +20%.

technologies.name: Imperial Age King
